labels.vacated_mpg: FITTED share rule (2024-25 + 2025-26 box scores, placebo-corrected): share 0.77 (SE 0.034) of the star's mpg, by depth bucket x primary-position match, x 0.95 calibration for free-agent-like players (FITTED, 2024-25 backtest); docs/research/opportunity_detector.md
labels.window_games: FITTED absence survival given games missed; with an ESPN return estimate the SHORTER of the two (PRIOR rule, both reported); capped at 20 games (PRIOR)
labels.thresholds: PRIOR: jump >= 4.0 mpg over preseason, vacated >= 2.0 mpg, absence observed after 2 team games, cap 40.0 mpg
labels.jump: a jump candidate's minutes are model A's (minutes-0.2.0) with no extra adjustment: the detector only surfaces 'model A says his minutes rose' (backtest: no incremental minutes beyond model A)
labels.per_minute_rates: kept from the in-season projections (FITTED: ratio during absences ~1.00-1.04)
labels.after_window: minutes-model level (model B mpg); no retention credit (conservative)
labels.window_value_gain_vs_drop: window games x (p_play x (base per-game value + value_calib x opportunity uplift) - the drop's); value_calib 1.0 FITTED (2024-25 backtest, docs/research/opportunity_detector.md); *_raw = uncalibrated
labels.evaluation: week: stream tool's matchup model (lineup-0.2.0), paired MC, candidate on a week line (the opportunity minutes for his first window games this week only); season: the stream tool's position-aware STREAM CHAIN (make_stream_season_eval): drop -> candidate on his window line for the window (to the day after his ceil(window)-th game) -> the 6th-best realistic free agent (season-sim-0.8.1); blend and market sets; ± = Monte Carlo SE only
labels.verdict: streamscan.stream_verdict on the chain (helps = ΔP(playoffs) or ΔP(title) > 2 SE under every set, neither < -2 SE, stream not worse than direct); speculative = noise but week ΔP(win) > 2 SE or the stint-vs-direct ΔP(playoffs) > 1 SE (PRIOR); direct_helps = the chain helps only through the drop; unevaluated = no chain run
